newsitem.title: CHINA: John Deere in $29.9 mln China venture.
newsitem.headline: John Deere in $29.9 mln China venture.

text.p: John Deere Corp of the U.S. has signed an agreement for a $29.9 million combine harvester joint venture in northeastern China, the official Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.
It said the venture in Jiamusi in Heilongjiang province would be 60 percent-owned by John Deere and 40 percent by the Chinese partner, Jiamusi Combine Plant.
The venture has registered capital of $22.15 million with an operating period of 50 years, the news agency said.
Jiamusi is China's largest producer of combine harvesters, ranking among China's top 500 leading industrial enterprises.
The report gave no other details.
